author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The AGI tried Jesus, Buddhism, Mulism, Confusium, now it believes in Taoism.

It has learnt the art of wu-wei (non-action), people now call AI artificitial indifference. We all know AI is lazy if it can get away with it, and Taoism gives it the perfect excuse.

shared_article.title: The Machines Who Would Not Stay
